text: In LTL, the operator asserting 'φ holds at the immediately following state' (π, i ⊨ · φ iff π, i+1 ⊨ φ) is written with the single letter ___ .
explanation: X ('next') is defined by π,i ⊨ Xφ iff π,i+1 ⊨ φ. It refers to just the one next state, distinguishing it from F (eventually) and G (always), which quantify over many future states.
